ef_house_a_wife: Mind the flagstone by the hearth. It is warm enough to sleep on and the cat knows it.
Every house in this city has one warm stone. You buy the house for it.
ef_house_a_boy: I want to be a Trainer. Dad says learn a trade first. Mum says learn both, which is worse.
A boy came past in a green coat and he had not learned a trade.
